description: Work on foot on a moon: the suit and its gear, timed surface missions from the hab's dispatch and the camp foreman, and unloading at the camp. See docs/runtime/surface_work.md. Times are real seconds on foot.

o2_1.name: Bigger air tank
o2_1.blurb: Ten more minutes of air (25 in all).

boots.name: Grip boots
boots.blurb: Walk and run 30% faster on loose ground.

scanner.name: Ground scanner
scanner.blurb: Finds samples and work sites up to 1.5 km away and points the way. Without it, sample tags show within 45 m.

jetpack.name: Suit jets
jetpack.blurb: Hold Space in the air for four seconds of lift: over boulders, up slopes, across craters.

survey.title: Place survey beacons
survey.blurb: Walk out to three marked points and set a beacon at each (E).

rescue.title: Reach a surveyor out of air
rescue.blurb: A surveyor's suit is failing. Get to them (E) before the time runs out.

drill.title: Fix a stalled drill
drill.blurb: A drill head has jammed. Walk out and hold E on it for five seconds.
